title: tk herd --help still advertises the deleted spawn/wait/collect command family
body: cmd/tk/cmd/herd.go's Short ('Drive a herdr session: spawn, wait for and collect a wave of agent workers') and Long text describe the orchestration contract of commands nkf deleted; only dashboard and relay remain as subcommands. No test pins the herd command surface, so the gate stays green while the help lies — a subcommand-enumeration test (herdCmd contains exactly dashboard and relay) would pin it. One-file fix; can ride along with the client-consolidation tick.
